messages:
Jess (Support): Hi team — customer Acme reports SSO started returning 403s for their users after an IdP metadata refresh. Ticket #CS-8241. Root error in our logs: `assertion consumer url mismatch` but digging deeper I see an XML signature error: 

Jess (Support): log excerpt:
```
2024-10-15T14:07:03Z ERROR saml: metadata verification failed: signature not yet valid: NotBefore=2024-10-15T14:12:00Z, now=2024-10-15T14:07:03Z
```

Jess (Support): Customer says they uploaded signed metadata from their IdP at ~14:10 UTC. Looks like the SignedInfo / signature timestamp on the metadata is slightly in the future relative to our metadata watcher. This causes our verifier to reject until NotBefore. Ticket says users hit a 403 on ACS POSTs.

Acme SSO Admin: yep — we rotated the signing key and exported new metadata from our appliance. We see the metadata file has a SignedTimestamp of `2024-10-15T14:12:00Z` (appliance clock was off by a few mins). We only realized after seeing the 403s. Can you force a refresh?

Jess (Support): thanks. Immediate options: 1) temporary workaround: upload the IdP cert directly to the tenant in the console (we can accept cert fingerprints) so auth will succeed even if metadata is held back; 2) or ask us to force-accept the metadata for this tenant (manual intervention). Before we do manual accept, can you paste the metadata URL and the <Signature> snippet?

Acme SSO Admin: metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml
Signature block (redacted):
```
<Signature>
  <SignedInfo>
    <Reference URI="#meta"/>
    <SignedTimestamp>2024-10-15T14:12:00Z</SignedTimestamp>
  </SignedInfo>
  <SignatureValue>MEUCIQ...</SignatureValue>
</Signature>
```

Luis (Eng Infra): quick diagnostic steps for SRE: curl the metadata and check HTTP headers and the embedded signature times, also check our metadata poller logs. Try:
```
curl -sS -D - https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml | sed -n '1,120p'
xmllint --xpath 'string(//ds:Signature/ds:SignedInfo)' metadata.xml  # or parse SignedTimestamp
```

Anya (SRE): confirmed from our replication of the metadata: SignedTimestamp is in the future. Our metadata watcher currently enforces signature validity strictly: signature.NotBefore <= now <= signature.NotAfter. We intentionally do that to avoid replayed/faked metadata. However we already have the previous valid metadata cached with same entityID; the issue is that metadata with future NotBefore sits in the cache as "pending" and we don't swap until it's valid — which causes mismatch between expected cert and presented signing key from IdP during login, leading ACS rejects.

Jess (Support): for immediate unblock I can manually mark the new cert as trusted for Acme's tenant in our internal admin panel; this will let ACS accept assertions signed by the new key while we coordinate the IdP to correct the timestamp. Do you want me to proceed?

Acme SSO Admin: yes please, we need users working now. Also we will correct our appliance clock and re-issue metadata.

Luis (Eng Infra): done — I uploaded the certificate fingerprint tied to the new metadata and flipped the tenant to accept it. I also added a one-off flag to bypass the NotBefore check for this entity for up to 10 minutes (internal-only emergency gate). Make sure to remove the gate after the fix. deploy-bot: triggered a small change to the metadata cache.

deploy-bot: deployment deploy/metadata-acceptance-gate succeeded — rollout to 2/2 instances in 45s. :white_check_mark:

Anya (SRE): recommendations for product/ops: we should consider a safe clock-skew allowance in the metadata verifier (e.g., accept NotBefore if it is within +5m of now and signature verification passes), plus a policy for emergency manual-accept that logs audit trail and expires automatically. That would reduce support escalations when customers have slight NTP drift.

Luis (Eng Infra): agreed. Also we need better observability: make the poller log exact NotBefore/NotAfter and the candidate vs active entityID cert fingerprint to make debugging tickets like this quick. Filed infra task INFRA-1286.

Jess (Support): notes I added to ticket: customer corrected appliance clock, re-exported metadata, confirmed new metadata SignedTimestamp=2024-10-15T14:13:10Z which is now within skew after correction. I removed the emergency bypass at 14:28 UTC. Customer validated login success at 14:30 UTC.

Acme SSO Admin: confirmed users can log in now. Thanks for the quick help — please keep us posted on any permanent changes so we know if we need to adjust our metadata process. :thumbsup:

Anya (SRE): followups: 1) add 5m skew window and a config flag per-tenant to enable stricter enforcement for high-security tenants; 2) instrument metadata watcher to emit alert when metadata contains future NotBefore so we can proactively notify customers; 3) add a documented runbook for support for certificate rotations (steps to upload cert fingerprint, force-accept, revert).

Jess (Support): adding runbook link to ticket: https://redwood.example/internal/runbooks/sso-cert-rotation. Also noting customer feedback to make the console show pending metadata with reason (e.g., "NotBefore in future").

Luis (Eng Infra): assigning INFRA-1286 -> metadata-skew-logging, SRE-221 -> metadata-skew-policy, DOCS-432 -> runbook edits. Closing support hotspot for CS-8241 after customer ack.

deploy-bot: CS-8241: note pinned in deploy log.

Jess (Support): closing thread — if anything reappears reopen or escalate.
